name: cross_engine_cases_v1
description: Matched emulator/Mininet validation cases. Every case fixes workload, trace, capacity, queue, scheduler, transport and switching conditions identically on both engines. Queue configuration comes from switch_calibration_v2 (per-path packet limits); emulator buffer_bytes must be mapped as limit_packets * packet_bytes in matched mode.

cases.purpose: queue saturation: offered rate exceeds sagged capacity on five_g; exercises buffer fill, overflow drops and queue-delay ceiling
SLA boundary: one-way delay just below the 150 ms voice threshold; sensitivity of the violation decision to jitter and small queue delay
SLA boundary with TCP: retransmission-driven loss estimate near the 5% interactive threshold
switch transient: interruption duration and loss burst on the highest-RTT contrast (leo -> bb)

statistics: median and p95 per metric per engine
two-sample KS statistic and p-value on raw replicate values
Cliff's delta effect size (negligible <0.147, small <0.33, medium <0.474, large otherwise)
comparison.threshold_rule: accept a metric when |median difference| and p95 tail ratio fall inside the within-engine reproducibility band derived from the calibration sweeps' replicate deviations (analysis/cross_engine_thresholds.csv). No fixed percentage thresholds.
comparison.gate: a case passes when all its metrics pass; the validation round passes when every case passes and no case is excluded without a documented reason
